The '''Taspan system''', also known as the '''Mindor system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], six jumps off of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in this system included [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] and [[Taspan II]].

During the [[Battle of Mindor]], the system was devastated.
